scope: Patient-isolated internal sensitivity using previously studied cohorts, original labels and original full-record inputs; no OMOP, harmonized transfer, prospective endpoint or new external validation.
roles: Reuse exact saved 5-fold patient roles from original_v5_independent_validation_v1: 0 outer test, 1 calibration, 2 inner fit, 3 inner stop; final sensitivity models refit all non-test patients. No calibration model is added.
value_indicator_ensemble: Original numeric preprocessing plus binary NaN indicators for nominal inputs having both observed and missing values in the fitting partition; 50:50 XGBoost/RandomForest probabilities. Indicators are generated before imputation. Constant indicators are not appended. All nominal input types are eligible, not laboratory orders alone.
native_xgb: Original NaN values passed to XGBoost; retain the original column order and fit-partition empty-column rule (Chinese nominal columns retained; MIMIC all-empty columns dropped). Compare with the frozen original-input xgb_full, not with the ensemble.
preprocessing: China retains original constant-zero numeric filling; MIMIC median imputation learned only from fitting rows and fitting-row empty-column removal. Native XGBoost does not fill NaNs. No zero value is reclassified as missing.
model_configuration: Exact frozen xgb/rf parameters and weighting policies from original_v5_independent_validation_v1/protocol.json; maximum 300 rounds, inner early stopping 20. Each variant independently selects its rounds using saved inner-fit/inner-stop roles, then refits all outer-training patients.
seed_policy: China XGBoost/RandomForest seed 42; MIMIC 1-based fold; outer roles unchanged.
bootstrap_unit: Patient with all admissions receiving the same sampled patient multiplicity; use identical draws across all methods within a cohort.
intervals: 95% percentile conditional on fixed OOF predictions; no model refitting or multiplicity adjustment.
feature_subset_sensitivity: Not included in this protocol; no coverage threshold or selected subset is chosen from performance.
shap: Store exact XGBoost pred_contribs on held-out outer-test rows only, with sum-to-margin check. These explain the XGBoost component in log-odds space, not the ensemble probability, clinical causation or missingness-adjusted importance stability.
